description.narrative: The project aims to facilitate economic transformation of Ivano-Frankivsk to higher added-value economic activities leveraging from existing economic clusters and emerging innovation ecosystem. The project will promote innovation and diversification, including creative industry and social economy; develop better business linkages, actively promoting municipality as good investment destination; supporting local infrastructure for economic growth, transitioning to greener and tech-driven economy.

This activity was planned as a tool to support local innovation ecosystem players in their ability to access and use various funding opportunities and raise their longterm capacity to operate available funding tools from Ukrainian government banks and international donors. We received lower number of requests than expected. Many entrepreneurs and business owners were sceptical about this option and didnt believe it could be applied to their business. Additionally often relocated SMEs did not have the obligatory for the application documents e.g. registration documents financial records etc.. Therefore we initially had to invest more time in informational seminars and events and messages via our communication platforms explaining and showing real cases of funding business. During the first year Funding Access Support Facility was concentrated on informing the representatives of small and medium businesses especially to the relocated ones about possibilities of attracting funds for their businesses. Most of the businesses had no idea about possibility of raising grant funds they did not know the rules and procedures. Thus the FAF Manager monitored all the possibilities and provided consultations.
